newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain reg unemployment may fall below 2 mln in Aug.
newsitem.headline: Spain reg unemployment may fall below 2 mln in Aug.

text.p: Spain's Labour Secretary Manuel Pimentel said on Wednesday registered unemployment may fall below two million people in August.
"Unemployment will probably fall below two million in August," Pimentel told journalists.
He said unemployment could rise back through two million in September, October and November but then would probably return beneath two million in December.
Earlier on Wednesday, Spain said registered unemployment fell to 12.5 percent in July, with 2.01 million people registered as unemployed, from 13.06 percent in June.
